title: Towards Scalable and Cost-Efficient Vulnerability Detection: A Study on Automatic Query Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.10412v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Static analysis remains a cornerstone of software security, yet the effectiveness of tools such as CodeQL is often limited by the substantial manual effort required to develop high-coverage query suites. While large language models (LLMs) have emerged as a potential solution for automated code reasoning, their practical utility in generating structured, executable security queries remains underexplored. In this paper, we conduct an empirical study to evaluate the ability of LLMs to synthesize CodeQL queries using vulnerability data from the National Vulnerability Database. Through this investigation, we explore the potential of using LLMs as an automatic CodeQL query generator. Subsequently, we systematically evaluate the performance of various LLM architectures across a diverse set of real-world vulnerabilities, measuring their ability to improve detection coverage and precision. translated_title: 迈向可扩展且高性价比的漏洞检测：自动查询生成研究
translated_abstract: 静态分析仍然是软件安全的基石，然而诸如CodeQL等工具的有效性往往受到开发高覆盖率查询套件所需大量人工工作的限制。虽然大语言模型（LLMs）已成为自动化代码推理的潜在解决方案，但其在生成结构化、可执行安全查询方面的实际效用仍未得到充分探索。在本文中，我们开展了一项实证研究，利用美国国家漏洞数据库（NVD）中的漏洞数据评估LLMs合成CodeQL查询的能力。通过这项研究，我们探索了将LLMs用作自动CodeQL查询生成器的潜力。随后，我们在多样化的真实世界漏洞数据集上系统评估了各种LLM架构的性能，衡量其提高检测覆盖率和精确度的能力。我们的研究结果表明，LLM生成的查询显著提升了漏洞检测效果，展现出作为漏洞检测自动化工具的巨大潜力。
tldr: 本文通过实证研究证明，大语言模型能够利用国家漏洞数据库数据自动生成有效的CodeQL安全查询，显著提升漏洞检测的覆盖率和精确度，为实现可扩展、低成本的漏洞检测提供了新途径。
en_tdlr: This empirical study demonstrates that large language models can automatically generate effective CodeQL security queries from National Vulnerability Database data, significantly improving detection coverage and precision, thus enabling scalable and cost-efficient vulnerability detection.
